verdict.rationale: Greenhouse's AI Notetaker feature clearly records and transcribes interviews and maps AI-generated summaries directly to scorecard questions, matching the core of the story (greenhouse-docs-9, greenhouse-docs-14, greenhouse-docs-21, greenhouse-docs-33). However, none of the evidence explicitly addresses candidate consent workflows (e.g., consent prompts, opt-out, recording notices) for the recording/transcription process. Missing for 10: explicit candidate-consent handling documentation, independent/hands-on validation of the consent flow and transcription accuracy.
